entries.reason: The runtime mock is an independent end-to-end harness smoke for manifest, artifact, scoring, persistence, and aggregation behavior. Mock+ consumes parts of that production path but does not replace the runtime harness.

Owner tests define intended required fields, enums, legacy branches, and semantic invariants. Schema-derived Mock+ recipes consume the current schema; deleting the independent owner assertions would let an accidental schema weakening disappear from applicability.

Runtime gate tests define and independently exercise the production detector, redaction, classification, and persistence oracles. Mock+ invokes those oracles with mutations and cannot safely become their only proof.
